items.title: Chew some Bubblegum
items.detail: Open a perk card pack or find Bubblegum from Robo Butler Collectron

items.title: Complete an Event or Activity
items.detail: Public Events spawn every 20 minutes; Activities rotate more frequently

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport; use V.A.T.S. to target the leg

items.title: Kill a Spooky Scorched
items.detail: Spooky Scorched spawn at Morgantown Airport and other outdoor Scorched locations

items.title: Plant a Crop in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Harvest a plant and plant the seed at your C.A.M.P. or workshop

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint on foot; fast travel does not count toward this challenge

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted items to vendors at train stations for fastest completion

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: Five to eight gnomes are at The General's Steakhouse in the Mire's walled garden

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and enter the Daily Operation instance

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town's Bounty Board in The Last Resort saloon

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has reliable robot spawns; use energy weapons

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Silva Homestead in the Forest or plant crops at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Pint-Sized Phantoms spawn at cabins and campgrounds; equip any outfit with Costume in its description

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Wavy Willard's Water Park in the Toxic Valley has reliable spawns

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench, then scrap it

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build and submit a slasher-themed C.A.M.P. or Shelter for a chance to win Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Special Scorched enemies spawn with increased frequency, dropping spooky treat bags and mystery candy.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Experience gains are doubled for all activities and gameplay.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance of catching seasonal fish this weekend.
